purpose: Offer alternatives, or introduce another possibility.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
A、あるいはB / あるいは + clause
Please submit the application by mail or at the counter.
Tomorrow’s meeting may be postponed or canceled.
Perhaps there is no reply because they are traveling.
formation: A、あるいはB / あるいは + clause
restrictions: Can mean either “or” or “possibly”; context distinguishes them.
mistake: Do not assume both alternatives must occur.
